title: New study shows a 10% azelaic acid formulation using Azepur99
summary: The peer-reviewed clinical study conducted by Skinome Research AB has evaluated the efficacy and tolerability of a minimalist anhydrous concentrate combining 10% azelaic acid with 0.1% retinal in blemish-prone skin. Azepur99 supplied by Azeco Cosmeceuticals was the azelaic acid used in the evaluated formulation
